children: Coca-Cola says more value-oriented pack sizes it's rolled out in some markets are paying off. During a call with analysts, executives point to new offerings like its 500 milliliter Super Can in Europe and an affordable single-serve package it now sells in South Africa. The company plans to continue to focus on its price-pack architecture going forward to draw more customers and transactions, CEO Henrique Braun says. "Affordability is working," he says. (kelly.cloonan@wsj.com)
